name: Question 15
worked_solution:
Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}ST & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & -5 & 2 \\ 2 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & -1 & 0 \\ 2 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3+0+8 & 2+0-4 & 3+0+4 \\ 0-5+4 & 0+5-2 & 0-0+2 \\ 6+0+4 & 4-0-2 & 6+0+2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}11 & -2 & 7 \\ -1 & 3 & 2 \\ 10 & 2 & 8\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Question 15
?

Find ST, if S=[1040−52202] and T=[3231−102−11].

a
[11−271321028]
b
[10−27−1321028]
c
[11−27−1321028]
d
[11−27−13210−28]
e
[11−27−132102−8]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

ST=[1040−52202][3231−102−11]=[3+0+82+0−43+0+40−5+40+5−20−0+26+0+44−0−26+0+2]=[11−27−1321028].
